sections.title: What Yeasts Are and How They Develop

questions.q: About how many species of yeasts are currently known?
Kendrick describes 'yeast' as a growth form that has evolved in many different fungal groups.
The yeast cells of *Candida* are basically conidia developing in which pattern?
Zymologists traditionally classified yeasts using mainly:
c: Physiological tests such as fermenting or assimilating sugars

questions.q: Roughly how many yeast species never develop a teleomorph?
Multilateral budding yeasts like *Saccharomyces* bud from many points, leaving:
c: Many scars, one daughter cell per site

questions.q: So-called 'fission' yeasts such as *Schizosaccharomyces* actually extend in what way?
Yeast meiosporangia are comparable to asci, but how do they differ from mainline ascomycete asci?
c: Different wall chemistry, and never produced in a fruit body
